preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 500 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of friends N is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(time_str.split()) == 2 and time_str.split()[0].count(':') == 1 and time_str.split()[1] in ['AM', 'PM'] for time_str in [P] + [L for L, R in friends] + [R for L, R in friends])
preconditions.description: All time strings (P, L_i, R_i) are in the format 'HH:MM AM' or 'HH:MM PM' with two-digit HH and MM.

preconditions.expression: all(time_to_minutes(L) <= time_to_minutes(R) for L, R in friends)
preconditions.description: For each friend, the start time L_i is less than or equal to the end time R_i in the 24-hour clock representation.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == N and all(c in '01' for c in line) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string of length N consisting only of '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: all((time_to_minutes(P) >= time_to_minutes(L) and time_to_minutes(P) <= time_to_minutes(R)) == (line[i] == '1') for i, (line, (L, R)) in enumerate(zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), friends)))
postconditions.description: For each friend i, the i-th character is '1' if and only if the meeting time P falls within the interval [L_i, R_i] (inclusive), and '0' otherwise.
